independence_scope: Package reconciliation of coordinator report, gates, exact independent reviews and guarded handoff. Reviewer authored petroleum-oily-sludge and independently reviewed sulfates; oily-sludge scientific acceptance is exclusively the different vanadium reviewer, not this package audit.

limitations: The institutional2016 manuscript includes referee frontmatter and internal editorial notes; final publisher PDF was not inspected and exact water trajectories are not imported.
Diffraction occupancy and restrained H-site models are not direct water mass balance; one broken crystal does not establish universal collapse temperature.
No independent re-refinement of deposited CIFs or validation against reflection intensities performed.
No microbial mechanism, isolated V recovery or industrial deployment established.
The historical abstract wording remains intrinsically ambiguous; the current owner makes that ambiguity explicit without changing measured terminal products.
Ackermann2009 deposit AM-09-052 was unavailable; raw detailed-coordinate reproducibility is not verified.

AY5 kornelite is a provisional database match in mixed patterns, not confirmed hydrated phase chemistry or a proven metabolic precipitation route. Oxygen exposure/drying and matched abiotic controls are unreported.
Later unlabeled patterns do not establish quantitative disappearance or absence; pH6.5 prose/peak-label tension remains.
No recovered iron product balance, criticality designation, microbial causal rate or industrial deployment is established.
No raw-metal assay reanalysis, experimental replication or sequence reclassification was performed.
Source lacks usable metal fraction/denominator, full input/output balance and matched metal controls; qualified residual concentration observations do not prove removal, biosorption or recovery.
Original full HTML was usable although PDF routes returned HTML/challenges. Ahmadi ESM is an earlier wastewater paper; Hentati context is not independent replication of the metal comparison.

Exact nucleotide browser/efetch tool access failed during independent review; retained official efetch bytes and their acquisition metadata were inspected directly. Manufacturer direct page returned403.
Correction/retraction and related-evidence search was bounded to the recorded queries; no exhaustive absence claim. No industrial deployment or economic recoverability is demonstrated.
This successor confirms the narrower final record, not the unresolved metal methods in the primary study; issue360 source gap remains separate from resolved accession issue361.
Exact locality of the1974 specimen is unknown; historical lower hydration analyses do not measure the refined crystal or establish a minimum occupancy.
The2012MSc thesis is primary research but not a peer-reviewed article. Inconsistent cell-angle/instrument/bonding metadata remain unresolved.
No raw diffraction refinement was reproduced. PrintedcheckCIF lacks structurefactors; no fulltest-set assertion or unconstrained experimentalH-coordinateclaim is supported.
No observed romerite conversion, microbial process, extracted product or industrial deployment is established.
Detailed modern structural/EELS full text was unavailable to the curator; metadata/challenge pages are not treated as inspected primary results.
Bulk wet chemistry and microscopic inclusions do not isolate mica-site V3+/V4+; no independent reanalysis or diffraction reindexing performed.
No organism, microbial mechanism, ore extraction balance, isolated V recovery or industrial deployment established.

corrective_issues.summary: Corrected the inspected GenBank accession version to KX495190.2 and documented replacement of .1; independent successor resolves F1.
Qualified the cavansite abstract interpretation as ambiguous rather than declaring a contradiction; independent successor resolves f1.

finding.title: Qualify the scope of Ishida abstract intermediate-phase wording
finding.description: The initially reviewed owner called the abstract statement of no intermediate amorphous phase conflicting with the observed terminal amorphous product. Intermediate can refer to a phase between the two dimorphs, so a contradiction is not established. Preserve the ambiguous abstract alongside explicit terminal products and avoid inferring that cavansite cannot become amorphous. The measured outcome and existing qualified mechanism remain supported.
finding.normalization_reason: Bounded wording overstatement in an otherwise qualified comparison; identity and dehydration outcome unaffected.
finding.disposition_reason: Corrected explanation now states explicit scope ambiguity, preserves terminal amorphization and protocol limits, and avoids asserting a definitive internal contradiction. Independent affected evidence check and exact reverse-patch proof support closure; final strict/history gates cover corrected bytes.

finding.title: Cited Z8 accession version differs from inspected GenBank flatfile
finding.description: Initial owner cited .1 while the inspected official flatfile was .2. Current owner title/URL and explicit predecessor distinction now match .2; original CREATE/dossier remain historical and a new corrective EDIT/addendum supersede their mistake.
finding.disposition_reason: Exact final source fields agree with official VERSION/COMMENT; original owner reconstructed by reversing only the narrow correction/provenance additions. Required current gates passed; no organism, mechanism, concentration or scale claims changed.

open_source_issues.summary: Oily-sludge residual metal concentrations remain qualified pending sampled-fraction, recipe, controls and mass-accounting clarification.

limitations: Package integrity and evidence-boundary check; no fresh independent scientific reassessment of the reviewer-authored oily-sludge owner.
Full source archives remain outside Git. Source hashes were checked where explicit file bindings exist; no raw-data reanalysis or coordinate refinement performed.

Native PR publication, hosted required checks, squash-shaped isolated preflight, queue merge, fresh-main verification, cleanup and Pages success remain future gates. No deployment or source-exhaustion assertion.
Runtime acceptance preserves its static-only scope and prior eight-test lineage; this audit does not pretend those tests ran again.
Original-main preservation receipt is checked against its before-manifest and current HEAD/status; guarded commit separately rechecks every nontracked byte/mode/link before mutation.
